aina.name: PPTist Slides
aina.description: Create, edit and export PowerPoint-style slide decks in the PPTist editor beside the conversation. Use it to draft a presentation from an outline, change slides the user has open, or export the deck as .pptx.

zh-CN.name: PPTist 幻灯片
zh-CN.description: 在对话旁的 PPTist 编辑器中创建、编辑并导出 PowerPoint 风格的演示文稿：根据大纲生成整套 PPT、修改用户打开的页面，或导出为 .pptx。

skills.name: Make a slide deck
skills.description: Use when the user wants a presentation drafted, slides added or changed, a deck reviewed, or a deck exported as .pptx in PPTist.

tools.name: get_deck
tools.description: Return the open deck: its id, title, size (1000 x 562.5 for 16:9), theme, and every slide's id, title and elements (id, type, box, text).

tools.name: get_slide
tools.description: Return one slide of the open deck as full PPTist JSON, to edit it with update_slide. Uploaded pictures show as "[omitted data URL]"; send that value back unchanged to keep them.

tools.name: render_slide
tools.description: Return a picture of one slide (the current one without slide_id). Hosts that do not pass canvas pictures to the model show it as [image omitted]; then check layout with get_slide.

tools.name: generate_deck
tools.description: Create a new deck from an outline, laid out with one of PPTist's 8 designed templates, and open it. The deck shown before is saved first. Content slides take 1 to 12 items; contents slides 1 to 20.

template.description: 1 red, formal; 2 city blue; 3 geometric, tech; 4 soft Morandi; 5 fresh green; 6 warm retro; 7 deep and steady; 8 light blue.

outline.description: Slides in order: {type:'cover', data:{title, text}}, {type:'contents', data:{items:[string]}}, {type:'transition', data:{title, text}}, {type:'content', data:{title, items:[{title, text}]}}, {type:'end'}.

tools.name: add_slides
tools.description: Insert slides written in PPTist's slide JSON (see the make-deck skill's schema) after slide after_slide_id, or at the end. Returns the new slide ids.

tools.name: update_slide
tools.description: Replace one slide (matched by its id) with the given slide JSON: background, elements and notes. Get it first with get_slide.

tools.name: update_elements
tools.description: Change some properties of elements on one slide, e.g. a text's content, an element's position or a chart's data. Properties not given are kept.

tools.name: delete_slides
tools.description: Delete slides from the open deck. The user can still undo it in the editor.

tools.name: go_to_slide
tools.description: Show one slide of the open deck to the user.

tools.name: new_deck
tools.description: Open a new, blank deck. The deck shown before is saved first.

tools.name: open_deck
tools.description: Open one of the user's saved decks (ids from list_decks). The deck shown before is saved first.

tools.name: set_title
tools.description: Rename the open deck; the title is also the exported file's name.

tools.name: export_pptx
tools.description: Export the open deck as an editable .pptx file, which the user's browser downloads.

permissions.reason: Save your decks so they are there when you open the canvas again.
